styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, short bold headlines in charcoal #2B2B2B with warm orange #E2792B accent underlines, no dense body text
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons, single warm orange accent #E2792B, consistent rounded label shapes
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale across the set, shoe always grounded with a contact shadow, consistent suede and rubber material rendering
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm premium casual-shoe e-commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white background #FFFFFF, warm paper-white #F4EFE7, charcoal text #2B2B2B and one warm orange accent #E2792B; neutral-warm studio lighting with a soft front-left key, gentle fill and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif for short bold headlines with warm orange accent underlines, no dense body text; consistent rounded rectangular info labels and thin-line icons; clean high-end footwear photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale across the set; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
